## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy notable for his distinctive physical features. He is described as having prominent, goggle eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane is driven by a clear ambition for his future career. He has consistently expressed a strong desire to enter politics and ultimately serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the local [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. He later joined the advanced class organized by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) to study and prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination in order to pursue a career as a teacher. Charlie engaged in these studies alongside his peers while navigating the academic dynamics of the class.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie Sloane and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are academic and social peers who both attend school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their relationship is characterized by a ongoing rivalry as they compete for the favors and good graces of the same young woman. Despite studying in the same advanced class together, their interactions remain defined by this mutual romantic competition.
